api.command: CLOUDFLARE_INCLUDE_PROCESS_ENV=true npx hush run -t api-workers -- pnpm --filter @slopcade/api dev

metro.comment: Slopcade brand Metro. Kills metro-amen first — metro and metro-amen are mutually exclusive on port 8085.
metro.command: tmux kill-session -t omo-slopcade-metro-amen 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; node ../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --dev-client --port 8085

metro-amen.comment: Amen brand Metro. Kills metro first — mutually exclusive on port 8085. Always clears Metro cache (BRAND_ID is baked into the bundle).
metro-amen.command: tmux kill-session -t omo-slopcade-metro 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; BRAND_ID=amen node ../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && BRAND_ID=amen WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && BRAND_ID=amen WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --dev-client --port 8085 --clear

ios.comment: Build + install slopcade on iOS simulator. One-shot: exits when done. Starts metro if not running.
ios.command: RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx expo run:ios --no-bundler

ios-amen.comment: Build + install amen on iOS simulator. Prebuilds ios/ for amen (bundle: games.amen.app). Run 'pnpm prebuild' afterward to restore ios/ to slopcade config.
ios-amen.command: BRAND_ID=amen npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && BRAND_ID=amen npx expo prebuild --no-install --platform ios && BRAND_ID=amen RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx expo run:ios --no-bundler

web.command: node ../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --web --port 8085

web-amen.comment: Amen brand web. Kills web if running first (same port 8085).
web-amen.command: BRAND_ID=amen node ../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && BRAND_ID=amen WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && BRAND_ID=amen WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --web --port 8085 --clear

storybook.command: npx hush run -t app -- pnpm storybook
